items.title: Irish regulator stops X training AI with data gathered by agents
items.excerpt: Ireland's Data Protection Commission intervened and X halted training its AI models on personal data collected by AI agents (Grok bot); the regulator cited significant concerns about agent-gathered personal data under GDPR.

items.title: Google says Russian speakers pulled off first-ever fully automated AI cyberattack
items.excerpt: Google threat intelligence attributes what it calls the first fully automated AI-run cyberattack to Russian-speaking actors, a possible inflection point for AI in state-linked cyber operations.

items.title: Joint statement from Department of Commerce and Department of Justice on Megaspeed investigation
items.excerpt: Commerce and DOJ publicly detail their export-control investigation of Singapore's Megaspeed over suspected diversion of Nvidia AI chips: opened in 2024, Nvidia records requested May 2025, Megaspeed put on Nvidia's no-sell list June 2025; the agencies rebut 'inaccurate' public reporting.

history_match.title: Department of Justice Launches Super Intelligence Task Force

items.title: Nvidia places chip exports under boardroom supervision after Huang's exit
items.excerpt: Nvidia's board created a standing National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee to supervise export compliance after allegations its AI GPUs were diverted to China.

history_match.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal

items.title: Jensen Huang agrees to face Congress over Nvidia scandal
items.excerpt: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and general counsel Tim Teter will sit for transcribed closed-door interviews with the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China select committees on Dec. 2 over alleged AI chip smuggling and export-control probes.

history_match.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns

items.title: Scoop: Democrats probe DOJ's role in OpenAI copyright fight
items.excerpt: House Democrats led by Rep. Chellie Pingree are circulating a letter to AG Todd Blanche questioning why DOJ filed a statement of interest siding with OpenAI and Microsoft in the NYT copyright case without consulting the Copyright Office or USPTO, demanding drafts and any outside input.

items.title: Actors in UK to get more rights over their 'digital replicas' in deal on AI protections
items.excerpt: An agreement secured by the Equity union gives UK actors consent and payment rights whenever AI-generated digital replicas of them are used.

history_match.title: EU member states finalize Digital Omnibus negotiating stance

items.title: Albanese signs on to Trump's AI supply chain pact before leaders' meeting at Quad summit
items.excerpt: Australia joins the US and Japan in the Pax Silica AI supply-chain pact to protect AI technologies against China's push to dominate, ahead of the Quad leaders' summit in the Philippines.

history_match.title: US allies deepen deal to guard AI supply chains against 'hostile actors'

items.title: Reports of AI-related child sexual abuse material rise 8,400% in two years, data shows
items.excerpt: New data show AI-generated CSAM reports up 8,400% in two years; campaigners call on governments to treat child sexual exploitation as a preventable public-health emergency.

items.title: The Nvidia Scandal Could Upend Chip Sales to China. Trump Wants to Keep Them Going
items.excerpt: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces attack for not blacklisting Megaspeed, but Trump backs the policy of continuing AI chip sales to China.

history_match.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China

items.title: OpenAI wants to stop deepfakes from overwhelming child abuse tiplines
items.excerpt: With NCMEC seeing an explosion of AI-related CSAM reports, OpenAI proposes a classifier approach to keep AI-generated material from swamping child-abuse tiplines.

items.title: OpenAI is following through on its vow to provide access to third-party auditors... kind of
items.excerpt: Six Apollo Research auditors will be embedded at OpenAI for four months, but under strict limits such as speaking only with staff OpenAI approves.

items.title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
items.excerpt: An AI-generated Sam Altman deepfake complies with Meta's rules on Instagram, exposing gaps in platform AI-impersonation and labelling policy.

items.title: 與, AI부정행위 특별법 제정착수…"수능 10년제한 올해부터 적용"
items.excerpt: 더불어민주당이 17일 세무사 시험 등에서 AI 활용 부정행위가 잇따르자 AI 부정행위 특별법 제정에 착수, 수능 응시 제한 10년을 올해 시험부터 적용하겠다고 밝혔다.

items.title: 여야, '수능 AI 부정행위' 우려에 처벌강화 등 법안 앞다퉈 발의
items.excerpt: 여야가 세무사 시험·수능 AI 부정행위 우려 속에 AI·스마트안경 부정행위 처벌 강화 법안들을 잇따라 발의했다.

items.title: 당정, '수능 AI 부정행위' 대책 협의회…입법 과제 등 논의

items.title: 정부, 글로벌 빅테크와 수능 AI 부정행위 사후조사 추진…입시제한도 10년으로 확대
items.excerpt: 한성숙 총리 대국민 담화: 글로벌 빅테크와 협력해 시험 후 AI 서비스 접속 기록을 분석해 부정행위를 적발하고, 수능 응시자격 제한을 1년에서 10년으로 확대 추진.

items.title: 美 백악관, AI 사고 자진신고 기업에 규제 책임 완화 권고
items.excerpt: 트럼프 대통령 AI 태스크포스가 12일 회의에서 AI 기업의 중대 사고 자발적 보고를 늘리기 위해 연방기관이 사이버 범죄 책임 정책을 완화하도록 권고했다(블룸버그 보도 인용).

items.title: OpenAI opens its cybersecurity tool Daybreak to NATO and European governments
items.excerpt: OpenAI is opening its Daybreak cybersecurity tool to NATO and governments including Germany, France and Poland; ENISA has already used it to find real vulnerabilities.

items.title: 정부 "AI 기본법, 기업 혁신 뒷받침하도록 보완"
items.excerpt: 과기정통부 엄열 인공지능정책실장이 AI 기본법 세부 규정을 기업 혁신을 막지 않으면서 기본권을 보호하도록 보완하겠다고 밝혔다.

items.title: INSS "북한 해킹조직, AI 활용 '정착 단계' 진입"
items.excerpt: 국가안보전략연구원 보고서: 바이낸스 63억 달러 탈취 사건에서 북한 배후 조직이 사내 AI 도구를 악용하는 등 국가배후 해킹조직의 AI 활용이 정착 단계에 진입.
